query:
SELECT tm.teamid,
               tm.userid,
               tm.roles,
               tm.deleteat,
               tm.schemeuser,
               tm.schemeadmin,
               tm.schemeguest,
               tm.createat,
               ts.defaultteamguestrole,
               ts.defaultteamuserrole,
               ts.defaultteamadminrole
          FROM teammembers tm
          LEFT JOIN teams t ON tm.teamid = t.id
          LEFT JOIN schemes ts ON t.schemeid = ts.id
         WHERE tm.teamid = $1
           AND tm.userid = ANY($2::text[])
           AND tm.deleteat = 0
           AND NOT $3::boolean
           AND (cardinality($4::text[]) = 0 OR EXISTS (
                 SELECT 1 FROM teammembers rtm
                  WHERE rtm.userid = tm.userid
                    AND rtm.deleteat = 0
                    AND rtm.teamid = ANY($4::text[])))
           AND (cardinality($5::text[]) = 0 OR EXISTS (
                 SELECT 1 FROM channelmembers rcm
                  WHERE rcm.userid = tm.userid
                    AND rcm.channelid = ANY($5::text[])))
